messages:
maria: Heads up — staging p99 jumped right after we swapped in the new checkpoint (v10-check2). Noticed around 15:23 UTC, routing /text-gen.
sam: seeing it too. p50 is fine but p99 went from ~2.8s -> ~5.9s on the gen route :grimacing:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout for model v10-check2: 7/20 completed (canary id 78)
anya: profiler snapshots look interesting — KV cache miss rate spiked, and batch sizes collapsed to tiny micro-batches. Kernel selector also moved to `matmul-adaptive` fallback for a chunk of requests.
leo: kernel selector logs: "heuristic -> adaptive when avg_token_len > 80". Tokenizer token lengths increased for some locales after the checkpoint change.
sam: that sounds like tokenizer length distribution changed and tripped our batch heuristics. Any idea which change introduced that? Bisect?
maria: did a quick bisect. It points at PR#2274 — it combined a tokenizer normalizer tweak with a config flip that set `batch_policy` default to `auto-v2`.
ethan: CI caught something similar; rtx-ci-gen-04 perf job failed — p99 2x baseline. I uploaded flamegraphs and kv stats to the perf bucket: gs://perf/staging/3098765432/
anya: quick mitigation: we can override the route to use `batch_policy: legacy` until we fix heuristics. Patch draft here.

```
route:
  name: text-gen
  model: v10-check2
  batch_policy: legacy
```

leo: we might also force a stable kernel until the batch-policy heuristic is adjusted: `force_kernel: matmul-stable` on the route.
maria: tested locally — forcing kernel + legacy batch policy brings p99 down to ~3s on sampled traces. I'm going to pause the rollout and apply the override in staging.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by @maria. Canary reverted to v9.8 (20/20)
sam: after this we should add a unit/integration test that runs tokenizer variants against our batching sim and include checkpoint variants in perf CI.
anya: filing the follow-up: issue #4120 — includes bisect notes, profiling artifacts, and suggested kernel/batch fixes.
maria: +1. Postmortem/short RCA for eng-runtime. Also need to revisit KV prefetch/warmup — the cache warmup gap amplified the p99 spike; TTL/prefetch tuning might reduce the blast radius.
leo: noted, I'll add KV warmup probe to the staging health checks :eyes:
maria: thanks everyone. I'll keep updates here as we roll the fix to prod once validated.
_meta: thread contains root message + replies, short Slack style messages, @mentions and code snippet
